scenario: `len(s)` returns the codepoint count per LSTR.2.1. A rule gated on `len(m.text) == 5` fires for a 5-character ASCII string. Fact lands in working memory.
rules_ds:
schema Msg scope logical:
    entity_id: String key
    text: String mutable

schema Hit scope logical:
    dummy: Int key

rule trig:
    Msg m where len(m.text) == 5
->
    emit Hit logical dummy: 0
